description: Renovate is the only dependency updater in this repo (see .github/ADMIN_SETUP.md — Dependabot stays alerts/security-only). Three scoped jobs, each carved out of the blanket `enabled: false` default below: (1) the LLM e2e harness's pinned Claude Code CLI version, tracking npm's `stable` dist-tag, deliberately lagged from `latest` — see test/e2e-llm/README.md for the bump procedure; (2) Go module updates across every go.mod in the repo (root, test/e2e-common/broker-driver, test/e2e-basic-mcp/agent — Renovate finds all three on its own, no per-directory config needed), grouped into one minor/patch PR and one major PR to keep volume down. That auto-discovery depends on the top-level `ignorePaths` below: config:base resolves to config:recommended, which folds in :ignoreModulesAndTests and its own ignorePaths covering `**/test/**` and `**/tests/**` among others; the `ignorePaths` here replaces that list rather than extending it, and this narrower list is the only reason the two nested test go.mod files stay in scope. Do not drop it as apparent redundancy — the two test modules would silently fall out of Renovate's scope with no signal; (3) GitHub Actions version updates across all workflow files, grouped into a single PR. Top-level `commitBody` carries the DCO sign-off that the `DCO sign-off` CI gate requires — this is why Renovate covers Go and Actions too rather than a second updater (Dependabot) being added: its commit-message config has no field for a trailer, so its commits can never satisfy that gate. `commitBody` is top-level rather than per-rule so it also covers lock-file maintenance and config-migration branches. The gate exempts nobody: an author-name exemption would be forgeable with `git commit --author`. The address must match the identity Renovate commits under (the hosted GitHub App uses this one), otherwise its PRs go red on the gate — the fix is to correct the address here, never to exempt the bot.

prBodyNotes: Before merging: run `./run-all.sh` twice from `test/e2e-llm/` against the candidate version, confirm 16/16 pass both times. See the README's bump procedure.
